svg.title: Analysis and placement
svg.desc: Snapshot source + settings; record identity and checkpoints. Measure speech / vocal protection with verified local YAMNet. Observe bounded video chunks with selected Ollama / Gemini adapter. Keep event times and real recurrence; measure synthesized narration. Fit only inside safe event interval at <= 1.15x; otherwise pause / unresolved
